name: Electronics and Embedded Systems
description: The course will deal with working of BJT and MOSFET, biasing schemes and single stage amplifier; differential and operational amplifiers, negative and positive feedback, applications of operational amplifiers (integrator, adder, subtractor, filter circuits, comparators); Logic Gates, Number systems, arithmetic operations, K-maps, multiplexers, de-multiplexers, latches, flip-flops, registers, counters, memories; FPGA based microcontroller board; VHDL programming for combinational and sequential logic circuits.
